en: Vintage black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a street corner with ornate multi‑storey buildings and numerous German shop advertisements. The largest building displays a huge painted sign reading "Pönitz Colonialwaren" on the gable, with smaller signs for cigars, wine, delicatessen and other products. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the cobbled street and sidewalk. At the top of the card is the caption "Kötzschenbroda. Bahnhofstrasse." The left margin bears the printer's imprint and date.
